an account that is active, or has a status the configuration does not list, matches a leaver by full name only, after the last day of work (and its grace days, when still-active is stated); a name is never an exact match
an account that is active, or has a status the configuration does not list, in an export with companyAccountsOnly, has an email address whose domain is not example.com
